scope: Read-only primary supplier research; no prices or purchasing. Candidate is not selected as a confirmed drop-in replacement.

candidate.ownership: New/unowned candidate; not an assumed owned module option

compatibility_gate.status: OPEN - no verified ZXHT80-200 shaft/coupler and front flange drawing. NEMA23 alone is insufficient.
compatibility_gate.front_datum: A motor replacement can preserve the module motor front mounting plane only when shaft, pilot and flange match. Keeping this datum would add32mm rear package compared with the56mm stock envelope.
must_verify: ZXHT80 actual motor pilot diameter/projection, four-hole pitch and fastener access
Existing motor shaft diameter, stickout and flat/key; primary module listing does not give them
Coupler motor bore, engagement, clamping geometry and alignment; if it differs, select a real matching coupling without assuming screw journal dimensions
Candidate complete motor/brake drawing, front pilot/bolt dimensions and88mm package reference plane
Motor current/driver compatibility and torque-speed performance with the actual moving Z load
Brake electrical/control sequencing, power-loss response, temperature/duty and allowable stopping energy
compatibility_gate.drawing_access: Supplier product fields and power-off behavior were verified. Full datasheet link is real, but image/PDF downloads returned403 in this environment; no unviewed mounting dimensions are asserted.

retrofit_addon.status: Not a supported drop-in add-on to current supplied motor
retrofit_addon.reason: Manufacturer requires a matching exposed rear shaft plus matching rear housing mount holes. ZXHT80 listing describes a single output shaft and does not establish those rear interfaces.

static_requirement.formula: T = (m*g + additional_downward_force)*lead/(2*pi). Reverse efficiency1 is a conservative torque upper bound; friction/detent holding is not credited. Multiply by chosen3x screening factor.
limits: Static holding comparison only; not a certified safety factor or an upgraded module load rating
Brake2Nm does not increase the module seller20kg vertical-load claim
Actual moving mass, overhung loads, coupler/ballscrew/ballnut integrity and dynamic stopping remain separate

engagement_delay_sensitivity.model: Unconstrained free fall upper-bound illustration, d=0.5*g*t^2; no screw/rotor-inertia credit. Actual response must be measured.
engagement_delay_sensitivity.interpretation: Static torque capacity alone does not establish acceptable drop during power loss. No brake application time or dynamic energy rating was recovered.
